at: When she bends at the mill he starts at her backside
alt: Magistrate’s lust starts at Wonganghami’s backside under vermilion at the mill.

at: silk pulled taut across her chest, a wink over the shoulder
alt: Fantasy Wonganghami — wink and cleavage in the corridor while he stands silently tormented.

at: Dancing girls asleep on his chest
alt: Bed full of sleeping dancers; he stares at translucent Wonganghami on the beam.

at: The third — red silk, bob — invents the hours
alt: Third daughter drives Wonganghami and the boy — stick and water bowls.

at: the Yamcha sprawl of a body that has run out
alt: Hallakgungi bloodied on his back in the yard; third daughter stands over him.
Carpenter ants help Hallakgungi stack millet seed on the hillside.

at: He walks until his shadow is longer than he is
alt: Hallakgungi and Sinrok on the west road; ants point west.

at: They laugh until they cannot stand
alt: Laughing flower — gray hood and fake beard; the house laughs itself bloody.

at: until the hall is slick with it
alt: Weeping flower — gray beard guest smiles while the hall cries blood.

at: Fake gray beard peeled with it
alt: Dramatic unveil: hood and fake gray beard off — young face over the third daughter.

at: he lifts her face by the chin
alt: Before the kill he lifts her chin to the lamp and admires her beauty.

at: the first time the name is said aloud in that house
alt: Birth — Wonganghami names Hallakgungi aloud for the first time.
